writer.description: Sets the allowed nodes. Available nodes: `paragraph`, `heading`, `bulletList`, `orderedList`, `quote`. Activate/deactivate them all by passing `true`/`false`. Default nodes are `paragraph`, `heading`, `bulletList`, `orderedList`.

writer.name: toolbar
writer.description: Toolbar options, incl. `marks` (to narrow down which marks should have toolbar buttons), `nodes` (to narrow down which nodes should have toolbar dropdown entries) and `inline` to set the position of the toolbar (false = sticking on top of the field)

writer.name: maxlength
writer.description: Maximum number of allowed characters

writer.name: minlength
writer.description: Minimum number of required characters

writer.name: placeholder
writer.description: Optional placeholder value that will be shown when the field is empty

writer.name: spellcheck
writer.description: If `false`, spellcheck will be switched off

writer.name: autofocus
writer.description: Sets the focus on this field when the form loads. Only the first field with this label gets

writer.name: default
writer.description: Default value for the field, which will be used when a page/file/user is created

writer.name: disabled
writer.description: If `true`, the field is no longer editable and will not be saved

writer.name: help
writer.description: Optional help text below the field

writer.name: label
writer.description: The field label can be set as string or associative array with translations

writer.name: required
writer.description: If `true`, the field has to be filled in correctly to be saved.

writer.name: translate
writer.description: Should the field be translatable?

writer.name: when
writer.description: Conditions when the field will be shown

writer.name: width
writer.description: The width of the field in the field grid. Available widths: `1/1`, `1/2`, `1/3`, `1/4`, `2/3`, `3/4`
